g.text: GDHUB-101 — refunds computed and issued by the platform

text.tspan: upsert Refund by providerRefundId → no second row
Unchanged: cancel before day 1 (full refund / release, checkpoint deleted)
curator declined or silent 3 days (hold released)
paid checkpoints only (a captured or held Payment)
row: project · Checkpoint N · stage · curator (or AI) · status
∧ payment COMPLETED ∧ no checkpoint refund yet
one breakdown per reason, computed on the server
the amount is recomputed here, never taken from the client
parts: person 6 (5 calls + verdict) · AI 4 (3 reviews + final review with verdict)
CHECKPOINT_PARTS in config — the curator's fee (GDHUB-74) reads the same
person — sessions with curatorJoinedAt + 1 if the verdict was sent
AI — reviews written + 1 if the verdict was sent
paid = Payment.amount (minor units, after the promo code)
kept = floor(paid × provided ÷ parts) ← rounding favours the author
verdict null and now > dueAt + VERDICT_DUE_DAYS (day 31)
frees the curator's hours, stops the reminders)
